title: RLT-5 special training program begins

paragraphs.text: Regimental Landing Team Five’s special training program began on 15 November. The battalion’s commander reported that training was very limited: Marines were away on temporary additional duty at schools, higher headquarters imposed other commitments, and on-board strength was approximately 50%.

notes: November 15 is the program’s start date; no end date is stated. The half-strength figure describes the battalion, not each participating company.
